test_stimuli.name: pwm_channel_0_duty_50_percent
test_stimuli.derivation: For channel 0: off_l=0x00, off_h=0x08 => ((0x08 & 0x0F) * 256) + 0x00 = 2048. For channel 1: off_l=0x00, off_h=0x00 => 0.

test_stimuli.name: pwm_channel_0_duty_25_percent
test_stimuli.derivation: For channel 0: off_l=0x00, off_h=0x04 => ((0x04 & 0x0F) * 256) + 0x00 = 1024. For channel 1: off_l=0x00, off_h=0x00 => 0.
